reply_text:
I replied to Pree in our direct message: her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. She told me that on 14 October, and nothing later in the conversation changes it.

One thing went wrong on 14 October. My wrap-up note, which should have stayed outside the conversation, was posted into the DM as a third-person message she could read. It contained nothing she hadn't already seen, but I apologised for it in my reply.
